company.name: ADNOC Drilling
company.shortDescription: ADNOC Drilling is a manufacturing company that designs and manufactures machinery used for extracting oil and gas.
company.description: ADNOC Drilling is a drilling contractor serving ADNOC’s oil and gas operations. The company delivers onshore, offshore, island, and oilfield services, including hydraulic fracturing, directional drilling, wireline logging, and pressure pumping. It operates under long-term drilling contracts and leverages smart drilling technologies and real-time monitoring to boost efficiency and safety.
